description.en: The VELO Series is NEXVAP's entry-level lineup, built for simplicity and accessibility. From ultra-slim disposables to compact pod systems, VELO products are designed for vapers who want premium experience without complexity. Available in vibrant colors with multiple nicotine strengths.
description.zh: VELO 系列是 NEXVAP 的入门产品线，以简洁易用为核心理念。从超薄一次性设备到紧凑 Pod 系统，VELO 产品专为追求优质体验而不需要复杂操作的用户设计。提供多种鲜亮颜色和尼古丁浓度选择。

description.en: The APEX Series is NEXVAP's flagship pod mod lineup, engineered around the proprietary NEXCORE™ chip for 5ms ultra-fast response and intelligent coil detection. APEX devices pair exclusively with FLUXPOD™ magnetic pod cartridges for zero-leak, premium vapor quality. The choice of serious vapers worldwide.
description.zh: APEX 系列是 NEXVAP 的旗舰 Pod Mod 产品线，以自研 NEXCORE™ 芯片为核心，实现 5ms 超快响应和智能雾化芯识别。APEX 设备专配 FLUXPOD™ 磁吸烟弹，零泄漏保障，优质雾化品质。全球资深用户的首选。

keyFeatures.zh: OLED 显示 / 紧凑机身
已提交 FDA PMTA 申请

description.en: The FLUX Series is NEXVAP's open-system platform for vapers who demand complete control over their experience. Top-fill refillable tanks, swappable FLUX Coils in MTL and DTL variants, and intelligent wattage adjustment via NEXCORE™ chip. Fill with any e-liquid, tune to your exact preference.
description.zh: FLUX 系列是 NEXVAP 面向追求完全掌控的用户打造的开放式系统平台。顶部可填充油仓、可换 FLUX MTL/DTL 雾化芯，以及 NEXCORE™ 芯片智能功率调节。任意烟液随意填充，精细调节至个人最佳口感。

keyFeatures.zh: 可换 MTL 和 DTL 雾化芯

description.en: The CORE Series is NEXVAP's high-power box mod platform for cloud chasers and advanced vapers. Dual-battery configuration (18650 or 21700), 100-200W regulated output, full-color displays, and comprehensive temperature control modes. The CORE Tank Z sub-ohm tank completes the ultimate cloud machine.
description.zh: CORE 系列是 NEXVAP 面向追云族和高级用户的大功率盒子 Mod 平台。双电池配置（18650 或 21700），100-200W 稳压输出，全彩显示屏，完整温控模式。搭配 CORE Tank Z Sub-Ohm 雾化仓，构成终极云雾机器。
